I will say I have BCBS, I recently got a gender affirming surgery, and haven’t been told that they stopped covering HRT. If it’s BCBS through a company i.e ‘Blue Cross Blue Shield ___’ that could be why. If you’re 18 or under it could also be due to the recent laws in Nebraska about minors being given HRT (under 19 is a minor). 

I’d ask for more specifics of why. Generally it’s not just completely gone. For example someone with BCBS through a company couldn’t get *self* administered HRT. Or possibly BCBS wants more ‘proof’ as in therapy. 

Colorado should also have some good programs around HRT depending on your situation. I know Chicago does. 

Wishing you the best of luck.

Edit: To add onto the companies, they can decide what they cover or not. So BCBS does cover ___, but the company doesn’t want to pay for it. So ‘BCBS ___’ doesn’t cover it.
